d:
地铁口涌出的光浪将我们融化
玻璃幕墙折射出第七种蓝
你掌心的温度在柏油路上蒸发
我们踩着霓虹的碎片奔跑
影子在十字路口长出藤蔓
把每个黄昏编织成透明茧房
直到星辰坠落成摩斯密码
所有方向都成为同一种心跳的形状
彼之良·玉兰【城中光浴/仿生2.2CF系列/163Mcm】

Light pours out of subway entrances, melting us away,
the glass walls refract the seventh hue of blue.
The warmth of your palm evaporates on asphalt,
we run on the shards of neon.
Shadows grow vines at crossroads,
weaving each dusk into transparent cocoons.
Until stars fall as Morse code,
all directions pulse in the same heartbeat.
Bezlya Yulania CityLuminousBath, Bionic 2.2 CF series 163cm M ver
